message.content:
This editorial illustration depicts a large, stylized male character from the chest up, positioned against a white background. He has a round, jovial face with closed, smiling eyes, a large bulbous nose, and dark, slicked hair with a single curl. He wears a light-colored, button-up shirt and is rendered in a soft, painterly style with purple and pink shadows. He holds a rectangular red object, resembling a book or phone, high in his right hand. The text "PEMILIHAN LANGSUNG" appears in large, semi-transparent grey brushstroke letters layered over the character's raised arm and the red object.

Above the character, the red logo "TEMPO" is prominent, with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it. Smaller text at the top reads "Konflik Kepentingan Pimpinan KPK H.66" and "Agar Tiket Pesawat Tak Lagi Mahal H.80." Below the character, the text reads "PILKADA ALA ORBA," followed by a paragraph starting with "Rencana Presiden Prabowo Subianto" and ending with "H.28." A barcode, QR code, price "RP 50.000," and the date "23-29 DESEMBER 2024" are located in the top right corner.
